gwas_catalog.name: NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog
gwas_catalog.notes: Use for curated genome-wide association signals and trait/locus validation. GWAS loci are usually small-effect and ancestry/model dependent.

clinvar.name: NCBI ClinVar
clinvar.conflict_of_interest: Public NIH variant archive with external submitter classifications
clinvar.notes: Use for clinical variant classification. Always check current review status, submitter conflicts, and clinical assertion date.

clingen.name: ClinGen Gene-Disease Validity and Actionability
clingen.conflict_of_interest: NIH-funded clinical genetics resource; expert panel curation
clingen.notes: Use for clinical gene-disease validity, actionability, and expert-panel interpretation frameworks.

genereviews.name: GeneReviews
genereviews.notes: Use for monogenic disease clinical context, inheritance, testing limits, and management overview.

cpic.name: Clinical Pharmacogenetics Implementation Consortium (CPIC)
cpic.notes: Use only for how to interpret already-available PGx results. Does not mean raw DNA is sufficient for medication changes.

pharmgkb.name: PharmGKB
pharmgkb.notes: Use for drug-gene annotations and PGx evidence summaries. Clinical use still requires guideline and clinician context.

omim.name: OMIM
omim.notes: Use for rare monogenic disorder context. Consumer raw SNP data usually cannot rule in or rule out these conditions.

gnomad.name: gnomAD
gnomad.notes: Use for allele frequency and rare-variant plausibility checks. Frequency alone does not classify pathogenicity.

cdc_mthfr.name: CDC MTHFR and Folic Acid Guidance
cdc_mthfr.notes: Use to prevent common MTHFR overclaims; genotype does not mean folic acid cannot be processed.

pmdd_review.name: PMDD neuroactive steroid sensitivity review
pmdd_review.conflict_of_interest: None declared in accessible article metadata; verify article disclosures when using clinically
pmdd_review.notes: Use for PMDD framing as hormone-sensitivity/neurosteroid/GABA-related biology, not as a single-SNP diagnosis.

hpo.name: Human Phenotype Ontology
hpo.notes: Use to standardize symptom prompts and phenotype tags.

dietary_guidelines_2025_2030.name: Dietary Guidelines for Americans, 2025-2030
dietary_guidelines_2025_2030.notes: Use as general dietary-pattern baseline. Individual medical, allergy, religious/cultural and lab-confirmed requirements override general guidance.

usda_fooddata_central.name: USDA FoodData Central
usda_fooddata_central.conflict_of_interest: U.S. Department of Agriculture public data resource; data sources vary by food type
usda_fooddata_central.notes: Use for exact nutrient values and food lookup. This JSON stack stores rule tags, not full nutrient composition tables.

fda_major_food_allergens.name: FDA Food Allergies and Major Food Allergens
fda_major_food_allergens.conflict_of_interest: U.S. Food and Drug Administration public regulatory resource
fda_major_food_allergens.notes: Use for U.S. major food allergen categories; sesame is included through the FASTER Act implementation. Allergy diagnosis still requires clinical context.

usda_big_9_allergens.name: USDA FSIS Big 9 Allergens
usda_big_9_allergens.notes: Use for consumer-facing Big 9 allergen wording: milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans and sesame.

nih_ods_omega3.name: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements Omega-3 Fact Sheet
nih_ods_omega3.notes: Use for ALA/EPA/DHA distinctions, fish/algal sources and omega-3 supplement caveats.

nih_ods_folate.name: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements Folate Fact Sheet
nih_ods_folate.notes: Use for folate/folic acid intake context and lab interpretation with one-carbon metabolism markers.

cdc_mthfr_folic_acid.name: CDC MTHFR and Folic Acid Guidance
cdc_mthfr_folic_acid.notes: Use to prevent MTHFR overclaims and false folic-acid avoidance recommendations.

nih_ods_b12.name: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements Vitamin B12 Fact Sheet
nih_ods_b12.notes: Use for B12 food sources, deficiency risk and supplement/fortified food context.

nih_ods_choline.name: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements Choline Fact Sheet
nih_ods_choline.notes: Use for choline adequate intake, food sources, pregnancy context and deficiency/excess caveats.

nih_ods_vitamin_d.name: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements Vitamin D Fact Sheet
nih_ods_vitamin_d.notes: Use for vitamin D intake/lab context; genotype does not diagnose deficiency.
